name: Bernardo Ortolani
original_name: ベルナルド・オルトラーニ
source:
[spoiler]The oldest out of the CR-5 leaders, Bernardo is clever, efficient and highly organized, making him a valued member. His perverted nature and jocularity does not get in the way of his proficiency at his job. He has known Giancarlo for a while, and they get along quite well. Sharing a similar sense of humor, Bernardo likes to call Giancarlo "darling" (and Giancarlo calls Bernardo "honey") in jest. To everyone that watches Giancarlo and Bernardo together, they get the impression that the two are very close. Bernardo is supportive of Giancarlo possibly becoming the next leader. 

His favorite color is purple, and his favorite food is coffee. In his spare time, Bernardo likes to fix and play with machinery. His CR-5 tattoo is located on his left wrist.[/spoiler]

[Source: [URL=http://www.tennenouji.net/product/03_luckydog1/charactor/index.html]Luckydog 1 official website[/URL].]
